snippet.title: Thief Gameplay RetroGaming Arcade Video Game Pacific Novelty 1980s MAME
snippet.description:
"Thief" was a super funky obscure arcade game that came out in 1981. It was basically a Pac-Man clone, but the arcade cabinet had a cassette player that would play this "police radio chatter" on a loop throughout the entire game!  The emulated version in MAME also includes the audio from the cassette tape.  VOLUME UP on this one!
